name: WHOIdentifierTypes
title: WHO Identifier Types
description: The identifier types code system defines codes for identifier types used throughout WHO content.

concept.definition: An identifier for the resource that was generated as part of creating the resource in a client application. The identifier captures the logical id of the resource when it was created, and is typically expected to be a globally unique identifier such as a UUID.

An identifier for the resource that was assigned by a server as part of creating the resource in a create or upsert interaction. The identifier captures the logical id of the resource when it was created, though this may be used by the client as well as part of a negotiated id assignment.
